title: Lore of Lockheed and Northrop crash retrievals without oversight

tellings.quote: the UFO front, you have all this lore of like the Lockheeds and Northreps engaging in crash retrievalss and not having proper supervision or oversight when it comes to the government.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a body of stories in UFO circles claiming that defense companies such as Lockheed and Northrop have recovered crashed craft. According to this lore, they did it without proper government supervision or oversight. If true, it would mean private firms hold such secrets beyond the reach of elected officials.
